SNGPL's own website confirms the company is real and operates a transmission network of ~9,539 km spanning Balochistan to KPK with pipe up to 42in diameter (https://www.sngpl.com.pk/, verified), and Wikipedia's SNGPL article (verified, contains 'Sui-Multan' + 'SNGPL') confirms SNGPL took over 'the existing Sui-Multan System' (349 km of 16in + 130 km of 10in) from PIDC at incorporation -- general corroboration of the parent corridor/company but NOT of this specific loopline by name, so this alone is only weak/contextual support. The decisive evidence is internal: this batch's own GulfPub (Petroleum Economist PE World Map) reconciliation run (batches/pakistan-gas/staging/recon-gulfpub-20260807/match_diff.json), an INDEPENDENT third-party dataset, contains two segments -- oid 9679 'Sutlej Crossing - Multan' (36in, Sutlej Crossing(Jalalpur)->Multan, operating, operator/owner 'Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd') and oid 9680 'AC1-X - Sutlej Crossing' (36in, AC1-X(Bhong)->Sutlej Crossing(Uch), operating, same operator/owner) -- both matched by the engine to P4098 on diameter (exact 36in match) and endpoints (Bhong...Multan). This independently confirms: (1) existence of a real 36in SNGPL-operated gas transmission line on the Bhong-Multan corridor, (2) diameter=36in exactly, (3) Owner/Operator=SNGPL, (4) Status=operating, (5) endpoints Bhong->Multan. Cross-checking the whole Sui-Multan family strengthens this: GulfPub independently carries FOUR distinct segments on this corridor whose diameters match the GEM family diameter-for-diameter in the same order -- P4090 (main) 24in vs GulfPub 24in, P4091 (Loop I) 30in vs GulfPub 30in, P4097 (Loop II) 18in vs GulfPub 18in, P4098 (Loop III) 36in vs GulfPub 36in (x2 segments). That exact diameter correspondence across all four sibling rows is strong evidence P4098 is a genuine, distinct physical loopline and NOT a duplicate/relabel of P4090/P4091/P4097 -- each loop was independently captured by a third party at the diameter GEM records. Classification as transmission is consistent with GulfPub's independent record (long-haul interprovincial corridor, no gathering/processing character). Tier=medium because only ONE independent source (GulfPub, source_tier 2 in this repo's registry) was obtained for the specific-segment claims; a second, publicly citable source (ideally an OGRA State of Industry report, SNGPL annual report fixed-asset schedule, or Urdu-language coverage) could not be reached this session (OGRA 403's WebFetch; SNGPL's PDF annual report exceeded the fetch size limit; WebSearch budget was exhausted before this row). validity.researcher_notes: GEM: LengthKnown=213.68 km, Diameter=36in, RouteAccuracy='very low (straight line/schematic)'. Independent comparison (GulfPub PE World Map, source_tier 2, batches/pakistan-gas/staging/recon-gulfpub-20260807/match_diff.json): two 36in segments matched to P4098 by the reconciliation engine -- oid 9679 'Sutlej Crossing - Multan' length_km=94.951 (geodesic 96.037) and oid 9680 'AC1-X - Sutlej Crossing' length_km=172.2 (geodesic 173.731) -- summing to 267.151 km self-reported / 269.768 km geodesic, both matched at diameter='exact' but s_length signals were only 0.449 and 0.813 (i.e. the matcher itself flagged length disagreement; match confidence 'yellow' both times, composite 0.53/0.50). This ~25% gap is material and should not be silently passed per the corroboration standing rule. Notably every OTHER row in the Sui-Multan family lands close to its GulfPub counterpart in length (P4090 main: GEM 288.06 km vs GulfPub 288.073 km, near-exact; P4091 Loop I: GEM 313.78 km vs GulfPub 288.073 km, roughly consistent; P4097 Loop II: GEM 256.82 km vs GulfPub 288.073 km, roughly consistent) -- P4098 is the outlier where GEM's figure is markedly SHORTER than the independent geometry, rather than roughly matching or exceeding it. Combined with the 'very low/schematic' RouteAccuracy flag already on this row, the most likely explanation is that 213.68 km is a straight-line chord distance rather than the actual routed pipeline length, which independent mapped geometry puts closer to ~267-270 km. No independent public source could be found this session that states an exact length figure for 'Loopline III' by name, so this is flagged as a reconciliation-driven concern for Update to resolve, not an applied fix.
